items.docs: A `GET` request sent to the endpoint root returns a list of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) packages associated with the specified organization. This endpoint provides comprehensive details about packages including their vulnerabilities, affected resources, and usage statistics. The results can be filtered by various criteria including package name, version, framework, and more.

params.name: package-path
params.description: The path containing the package name followed by its version (e.g. `lodash/4.17.21`).

items.docs: A `GET` request sent to the endpoint root followed by package name and version returns detailed information about a specific SBOM package. This endpoint provides comprehensive details about the package including vulnerabilities, affected resources, images, and usage statistics.
